notes.title: Patch 1.3.3.0
notes.notes:
Hey there, 
New smaller patch that includes:
- Full 21:9 widescreen support, including expanded artwork for all game backgrounds. 
- Additional minor fixes. 

We're currently doing private testing on the new difficulty modes we have in the works, and continuing with development of the expanded ending epilogues, cut content, and auto-save experiments. 

If you're interested in joining the private beta testing you can reach out to us on discord, or wait until we roll out the public testing branch here. 

Thanks for the continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2.0
notes.notes:
Hey there, smaller round of fixes in anticipation of the next larger updates!

- Fixed issue rewinding back to week 1 reverting the stowaway choice. 
- Fixed issue with interview and medbay healing priority ordering. 
- Fixed fact badge popups being cut off screen on smaller resolutions (including steamdeck) 
- Fixed choice spacing, and dialogue lines being cut off on smaller resolutions.
- Fixed ending the week underdeck on the temperance causing camera issues. 
- Fixed [spoiler]Leopard Seal[/spoiler] attack balancing issue.
- Fixed some manifest card UX issues when playing with mouse and keyboard at the same time. 
- Fixed issue with emote staging delays when holding Ctrl to skip dialogue.
- Fixed issue using Medical Comforts on shore camp. 
- Various minor visual fixes. 

Widescreen support, balancing updates and expanded epilogues are currently undergoing internal testing before being rolled out next! Thanks again, for the continued feedback and reporting!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1.0
notes.notes:
Hey there, 
We're wrapping up some quick rounds of smaller reported issues before rolling out the next larger 1.4.0.0 update.

[h1]1.3.1.0 Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed loading saves from the map screen resulting in some visual glitches.
- Fixed Cordell ending dissonance bugs.
- Fixes to late game character emotes.
- Fixed issue with Stowaway choice being reverted when loading back to week 1 of the expedition after having completed the game.
- Additional Crew Manifest card fixes.
- Fixes to controller/keyboard input, including choice selection desync.
- Fixed visible player cabin on the ice.
- Auto Save in week 3 moved to the first line of the week.
- Fix to corrupted settings.config files preventing game start.
- Rationing slider selection now auto default to what you can afford that week, if you can’t afford Normal rations.
- Mr. Glossly is now understandably sad if you [spoiler]interrupt his report by killing the entire penguin colony.[/spoiler]
- Repositioned Grimley’s evening conversation location in first camp to make controller/keyboard selection smoother.
- Various typo and grammar & ludonarrative fixes.
- Various minor visual fixes.
- Various minor technical fixes.

[h1]Next up![/h1]
- Continued support and fixes of smaller issues.
- Full widescreen support, including new artwork and a complete pass of alternate resolutions, & UI clipping issues. (including SteamDeck)
- Balancing BETA branch, where players will be able to try out new difficulty modes, rebalances, mechanics & UX improvements.

For the small amount of reported hardware specific issues, we're doing our best to recreate and resolve them where we can. 
Don't be afraid to reach out to us on discord and we can look at your save data directly. 
It's been a huge help to us improving the game. 

Thanks again for continuing to provide feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0.0 - Updated Save System
notes.notes:
We’ve updated how the save system works, based on player feedback and observed play to reduce the amount of replay time needed on first time runs. 

- All save files are now permanently unlocked and accessible.
- Reverting to an earlier save file on a line will rewind progress on that line line back to that save file.
- Spoiler: [spoiler]Going to an earlier save file on a stained line, having eaten the fruit, will instead branch out into a new line without rewinding the line.[/spoiler]
- You can still manually delete and prune saves using the tree.
- The Left Ctrl button (PC/Mac) and Circle/B on controller can be held down to quickly skip through dialogue without accidently choosing choices
- Existing save tree structures will still exist, no existing saves will be deleted from updating the game to the new behaviour.
- Variety of smaller bug and script fixes.

If anyone has any bugged saves that are preventing them from progressing further with the game, don’t be afraid to get in touch with us on Discord [https://discord.gg/eCYNEmw8](https://discord.gg/eCYNEmw8) and we can look at your saves directly.  

We’ll be continuing to support the game with additional updates and fixes. 
The next big update in the works is full widescreen support for the game, we’ll also be setting up a beta testing branch for balancing updates and future content testing. 

Once again, thanks for all of the feedback and helping us to make The Pale Beyond better!

notes.title: Patch notes for 1.2.2.00
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where Tinned lemons were healing scurvy, but crew were remaining invalid. Invalid crew with no afflictions should have the invalid status removed when loading into a save.
- Better UX, explaining the Save Tree, and it’s ability to let you access locked saves by deleting the saves above it in the tree branch.
- Popup when returning to the Main Menu to remind you that quitting mid week will loose your progress for that week of the expedition.
- You can use the Ctrl key on keyboard to skip quickly through lots of dialogue without accidently choosing choices. (Same as B/Circle on controller)
- Dogs replenish after [spoiler] the Ice Splitting event.[/spoiler]
- Fixed soft lock if you held E to advance the week after [spoiler]choosing to lock down for winter at the furnace. [/spoiler]
- Various Misc Bug Fixes.

Known Issues we’re prioritising for 1.2.3
- Any remaining Issues [spoiler] setting sail on the life boats, under specific circumstances.[/spoiler]
- Errors in the resource UI regarding dogs, being incorrectly calculated in the number previews.
